coordinateConvention: Runtime samples the north-at-top cylindrical mosaic; absolute longitude/prime-meridian alignment is unverified.
heightPolicy: Uranus is an ice giant: no solid terrain or height files are emitted. Atmospheric color and band/brightness appearance are never elevation.

provenance.citation: Hubble OPAL Uranus 2014a WFC3/UVIS F467M/F547M/F658N global color composite, NASA/ESA/STScI; southern missing coverage is synthetic approximation.
provenance.coverage: Observed northern and equatorial clouds in a global cylindrical mosaic; the unobserved southern cap is smooth approximate color/bands, not Hubble data.
provenance.license: OPAL data use CC BY 4.0; credit NASA/ESA/STScI and the OPAL team.
provenance.processing: Pinned 721x361 Hubble TIFF; no-data southern rows and the ragged observation edge are blended across a 65-pixel latitude band into a pale synthetic atmospheric fill. Derived JPEGs are capped at native source resolution; color only, no terrain.
provenance.orientationEvidence: OPAL cylindrical map is used without flip or rotation; absolute prime-meridian alignment remains unverified.
